facts.business: Ola Electric develops, manufactures, and sells electric two-wheelers (Automotive business) and develops and manufactures advanced battery cells for captive mobility, energy storage, and selected external applications (Cell business).

capacity_or_capex.item: Expansion of cell manufacturing plant capacity from 5 GWh to 6.4 GWh by subsidiary Ola Cell Technologies Private Limited
Investment into research and product development

key_risks: Sustainability of gross margin dependent on product mix, pricing, commodity costs, localisation, manufacturing absorption, incentive eligibility and warranty performance
Ability to preserve service, margin and cost discipline while rebuilding volumes
Geopolitical and other external factors affecting supply chain resilience
Going concern dependency on successful equity capital raise through proposed QIP
